name: yf_multi_ticker_history
description:
Daily price history for several tickers in one call from Yahoo Finance (yfinance download).
Returns: {symbols, period, data_points: {SYMBOL: days in the period}, truncated, data: {SYMBOL: the most recent limit rows, oldest first, of {Date, Open, High, Low, Close, Adj Close, Volume}}}; Close is split-adjusted, Adj Close also for dividends; at most 10 tickers, more is an error.
Inputs (* required): symbols* (up to 10, separated by spaces or commas); period (1d, 5d, 1mo, 3mo, ...; default 1mo); limit (rows per ticker, 1-500; default 30).
One ticker with up to 1000 bars: yf_stock_history; fundamentals side by side: yf_compare_stocks.
Example: {"symbols": "AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL", "period": "3mo", "limit": 10}

symbols.description: Up to 10 tickers separated by spaces or commas, e.g. "AAPL MSFT GOOGL"
